public.title: Rotting Oranges
public.description: grid is a rectangular matrix with 1 to 30 rows and columns. 0 is empty, 1 is fresh, and 2 is rotten. Every minute all currently rotten oranges simultaneously rot fresh orthogonal neighbors. Return minutes until no fresh orange remains, or -1 if some cannot rot. Return zero if no fresh orange exists initially.
hints: Start BFS simultaneously from every rotten orange.
Count fresh cells to detect unreachable leftovers.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Multi-source BFS timestamps each newly rotten orange. The last timestamp is the elapsed time if every fresh cell was reached. O(rows*columns) time and space.
